description: Remove unused qrcode npm dependency from frontend, fix nginx.conf proxy port. Fix 5 e2e specs that depend on deleted services-status.json agent file. Fix 03-file-upload.spec.ts wrong shareUrl assertion. Fix port 8080 hardcoded in 07-security.spec.ts, demo-live.spec.ts, e2e/demo/live-demo.ts. Fix port 8080 in README.md (13+ occurrences). Create CONTRIBUTING.md. FEAT-003 is independent of FEAT-002 (different files) but should run after FEAT-001 to ensure services-status.json is already gone.
steps: Read frontend/package.json before editing. Remove '"qrcode": "^1.5.3"' from dependencies and '"@types/qrcode": "^1.5.5"' from devDependencies. Then run: cd d:\PROJECT-FINAL\Kiro\QR-CODE\frontend && npm install to regenerate package-lock.json.
Read frontend/nginx.conf before editing. Change 'proxy_pass http://backend:8080;' to 'proxy_pass http://backend:8787;'.

Read e2e/tests/01-homepage.spec.ts before editing. Remove the module-level services-status.json reading (lines: 'const statusPath = ...', 'const status = JSON.parse(...)', 'const BASE_URL = status.frontendUrl ...'). Replace BASE_URL with: 'const BASE_URL = process.env.BASE_URL || "http://localhost:5173";'. Remove the 'import * as fs from "fs"' and 'import * as path from "path"' imports since they were only used for reading services-status.json (check: path is also used for resultsDir — keep path if it is still used). Keep 'import * as path from "path"' if the test still uses path.join for the resultsDir.

Read e2e/tests/10-responsive.spec.ts before editing. Apply same fix as step 3: replace module-level statusPath/status/BASE_URL block with 'const BASE_URL = process.env.BASE_URL || "http://localhost:5173";'. Check: does this file use fs or path for anything other than services-status.json? Keep relevant imports.

Read e2e/tests/02-text-qr.spec.ts before editing. The services-status.json reading is inside a test function, not at module level. Inside test '02 - UI: text QR page loads and generates QR': remove the statusPath/status block, replace with 'const BASE_URL = process.env.BASE_URL || "http://localhost:5173";'.

Read e2e/tests/03-file-upload.spec.ts before editing. (a) Inside test '03 - upload test-small.txt': remove statusPath/status block, replace with 'const FRONTEND_URL = process.env.BASE_URL || "http://localhost:5173";'. (b) Inside test '03 - upload screenshot': same replacement. (c) Fix the wrong shareUrl assertion: change 'expect(data.shareUrl).toMatch(/\/api\/files\/share\//)' to 'expect(data.shareUrl).toMatch(/\/share\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/)' and add 'expect(data.shareUrl).not.toContain("/api/files/share/")'. (d) Fix the download URL: the fetchBuffer call uses data.shareUrl directly, but shareUrl is now the SPA route (http://...8787/share/token), not the download endpoint. Replace: 'const downloadedBuf = await fetchBuffer(data.shareUrl)' with: 'const token = data.shareUrl.split("/share/")[1]; const downloadedBuf = await fetchBuffer(`${API_URL}/api/files/share/${token}`)'.

Read e2e/tests/11-golden-e2e.spec.ts before editing. The statusPath block is inside the test function. Remove statusPath/status/FRONTEND_URL block. Replace with 'const FRONTEND_URL = process.env.BASE_URL || "http://localhost:5173";'.

Read e2e/tests/07-security.spec.ts before editing. In the test '07 - upload without file returns 400 or 500', find the raw http.RequestOptions block. Change 'port: 8080' to 'port: parseInt(new URL(API_URL).port) || 8787'. No import changes needed (http is already imported).

Read e2e/tests/demo-live.spec.ts before editing. Change 'const API_URL = "http://localhost:8080";' to 'const API_URL = process.env.API_URL || "http://localhost:8787";'. In the uploadViaApi function, the hardcoded 'port: 8080' and 'hostname: "localhost"' must also be replaced — change to use URL parsing: 'const urlObj = new URL(`${API_URL}/api/files?expirationMinutes=${expirationMinutes}`); const options = { hostname: urlObj.hostname, port: parseInt(urlObj.port) || 8787, path: urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search, ... }'. In deleteFile function, same: replace '{ hostname: "localhost", port: 8080, path: `/api/files/${id}`, method: "DELETE" }' with URL-parsed form using API_URL.

Read e2e/demo/live-demo.ts before editing. Change 'const API_URL = "http://localhost:8080";' to 'const API_URL = process.env.API_URL || "http://localhost:8787";'. Change the final console.log that contains the hardcoded absolute path 'd:\\PROJECT-FINAL\\Kiro\\QR-CODE\\backend\\storage\\' to './backend/storage/'.

Read README.md before editing. Make all port 8080 → 8787 replacements listed in cleanup-plan.md Phase F-3 (13+ occurrences). Also fix the shareUrl example in API Reference: change '/api/files/share/' to '/share/' and port 8080 to 8787. Fix LAN Mode section. Fix project structure — replace 'model/' with 'storage/ # Plain Java POJOs (no ORM)'.

Create CONTRIBUTING.md at root. Content: prerequisites (Java 21, Maven 3.9+, Node.js 18+), dev mode (start-dev.ps1), LAN mode (start-lan.ps1), backend tests (cd backend && mvn test), e2e tests (cd e2e && npx playwright test), brief code conventions, how to extend storage backend.
Run: cd d:\PROJECT-FINAL\Kiro\QR-CODE\frontend && npm run build — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors.
Run: cd d:\PROJECT-FINAL\Kiro\QR-CODE\frontend && npm run lint — must exit 0 with 0 errors.
Run: cd d:\PROJECT-FINAL\Kiro\QR-CODE\e2e && npx tsc --noEmit — must compile without errors.

e2e/tests/01-homepage.spec.ts, 02-text-qr.spec.ts, 03-file-upload.spec.ts, 10-responsive.spec.ts, 11-golden-e2e.spec.ts contain no reference to services-status.json
e2e/tests/03-file-upload.spec.ts shareUrl assertion uses /share/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ pattern and download uses API_URL
e2e/tests/demo-live.spec.ts has no hardcoded port 8080 and uses process.env.API_URL
e2e/demo/live-demo.ts has no hardcoded port 8080 and no hardcoded absolute Windows path
README.md contains no occurrence of port 8080
cd frontend && npm run build exits 0
cd frontend && npm run lint exits 0
